scope: Language models (chat, reasoning, completions, code, search, computer-use and deep-research IDs, and OpenAI fine-tune families) with a shutdown date on or after 1 July 2025, from four official pages: OpenAI's deprecations page, Anthropic's model deprecations doc, the Gemini API deprecations page and Vertex AI's model versions page. Audio, realtime, speech, transcription, image, video, embedding and moderation models are left out.
priceBasis: US dollars per million tokens at the standard tier, text input, shortest context tier, as listed on the provider's pricing page on the date seen. A ratio is the replacement's price divided by the retiring model's; it ignores differences in how many tokens each model uses.

entries.priceNote: Not listed on OpenAI's pricing page when checked on 8 October 2026, so no ratio is given.

breaks.short: a non-default temperature, top_p or top_k returns a 400 error
breaks.text: Claude 4.7 and later models return a 400 error when temperature, top_p or top_k is set to a non-default value. Anthropic's Python SDK v1.0 and later removes these parameters, so passing them raises a TypeError. Omit them and guide the model with the prompt.

breaks.short: a newer tokenizer counts about 30% more tokens for the same text
breaks.text: Claude 4.7 and later models use a newer tokenizer that produces approximately 30% more tokens for the same text, so the same prompt can cost more than the per-token ratio suggests. Measure on your own prompts.

notes: Dates apply to the Claude API, Claude Platform on AWS and Microsoft Foundry. Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud set their own retirement schedules.
